RubySchema

Catch config mistakes in your editor, not in production.

JSON Schemas for the config files in your Ruby project. Your editor flags invalid keys, suggests valid options and shows inline docs as you type. 24 schemas. Tested against real fixtures.

Install in Rails Browse schemas

Validation and auto-complete for Kamal’s deploy.yml, from the YAML language server.

Quick start

bin/rails app:template LOCATION=https://www.rubyschema.org/rails.rb

Adds a schema comment to each supported config file in your Rails app. Safe to re-run when new schemas are added. View the template.

Manual setup

YAML

# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>

JSON

{ "$schema": "<url>" }

TOML

#:schema <url>

Works with the YAML language server and any JSON Schema-aware editor, including VS Code, Neovim and Zed.
